The partnership enables members to earn Skywards Miles on eligible everyday purchases, including fuel, groceries, car washes and vehicle servicing, across ENOC’s UAE network. The network includes more than 215 ZOOM convenience stores, 54 AutoPro automotive service centres and 49 ProWash facilities.

Hamdan bin Mohammed inaugurates the Ahmed Khamis Al Hameli School at the Joint Aviation Institute. The school honours the memory and distinguished service of one of the UAE’s aviation pioneers, who helped lay the foundations of military aviation in the country. Naming the school after him reflects the UAE’s tradition of honouring those who have served the nation with dedication. His Highness also attends a graduation ceremony for military personnel who have completed specialised courses in joint aviation.
